description: D&D 5.5e (SRD 5.2.1) representative subset for the Champion Fighter, levels 1-3: four species (Human, Dwarf, Goliath, Halfling), the SRD's four backgrounds and four origin feats, the Fighter with its four Fighting Style feats and its level 2-3 advancement, the Champion subclass, every Simple and Martial weapon (all eight mastery properties), the armor list, and the starting-equipment packages. Content transcribed from the SRD 5.2.1 PDF (mirrored as Markdown at https://github.com/your5e/5e-srd-markdown, dnd/521).
